statement: Quantitative trace-reconstruction bounds with a uniform decoder. At every fixed deletion probability in $`(0,1)`$, reconstructing an arbitrary length-n binary string requires $`n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}`$ independent traces, ruling out polynomial-sample reconstruction. A uniform decoder achieves quasipolynomial sample and running-time bounds for known fixed rational retention probabilities. When the deletion probability is at most $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$ for fixed ε > 0, both bounds become polynomial in the input and parameter encoding.
